## Other equations of state and the capture allow-list (`moist-mixture`, `aneos`, `shallow-water`) {#sec-ch02-other-eos}

### Summary

Besides the ideal gas and the ideal-moist closure, snapy has three more closures. `moist-mixture` hands the
whole thermodynamics to kintera, including a nonideal gas. `aneos` reads a tabulated equation of state for
condensed matter from a file. `shallow-water` is not a gas at all: it has no energy row. This section gives each
closure in one paragraph, says which keys it answers, and records the one property they share at the pin: a
CUDA graph refuses all three, so a block that uses one runs eager. The full closures follow in
@sec-ch02-moist-mixture, @sec-ch02-aneos and @sec-ch02-shallow-water.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** The three closures other than @sec-ch02-ideal-gas and @sec-ch02-ideal-moist.

**Data.** As in @eq-ch02-laws-state; `shallow-water` has no `IPR` row and no species.

**Placement.** The same keys as every closure: `"U->W"`, `"W->U"`, the sound-speed keys.

**Activation.** `dynamics/equation-of-state/type`; capture refuses all three (default execution runs them eager).

**Guarantee / limits.** No anomaly storage; no CUDA graph.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch02-other-eos-tests: `test_eos.release` (moist-mixture), `test_aneos_gamma.release`.
:::

### Derivation

#### moist-mixture

The state keys are kintera's. From $\rho$ and $y_n$, `"DY->V"` forms the molar concentrations $\tilde c_n$[^rg-642707a05b55];
`"VU->T"` inverts the internal energy for $T$; `"VT->P"` gives $p=\mathcal RT\sum_{\mathrm{gas}}Z_n\tilde c_n$.
`MoistMixtureImpl::_cons2prim` ({{< code src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp MoistMixtureImpl::_cons2prim >}}) runs these
three after the shared density and velocity step of @eq-ch02-laws-state. The ratio of specific heats is
$\gamma=\sum_n\tilde c_nc_{p,n}/\sum_n\tilde c_nc_{v,n}$ in molar form, from
`MoistMixtureImpl::_adiabatic_index`
({{< code src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp MoistMixtureImpl::_adiabatic_index >}}). The sound speed is
$c_s=\sqrt\gamma\,c_T$ with the isothermal speed

$$
c_T^2=\frac{\mathcal RT}{\rho}\sum_{\mathrm{gas}}\Bigl(Z_n+\tilde c_n\frac{\partial Z_n}{\partial\tilde c_n}\Bigr)\tilde c_n,
$$

from `MoistMixtureImpl::_isothermal_sound_speed`
({{< code src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp MoistMixtureImpl::_isothermal_sound_speed >}}), the closure's
@eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed. This is $(\partial p/\partial\rho)$ at fixed $T$ and composition when each $Z_n$[^rg-48897db479d9]
depends on its own $\tilde c_n$ only: scale every $\tilde c_n$ by $\lambda$ and differentiate $p$ at
$\lambda=1$ (`[V10]` of `v3_relations_check.py`, under that assumption). **That assumption is unverified**: it is
settled by reading, at the kintera pin 0429d795, the `czh` and `czh_ddC` tables that `tables_for` builds and the
`call_func2` kernel that `eval_czh_ddC` runs (the open issue of @sec-ch02-moist-mixture). The keys are answered by
`MoistMixtureImpl::compute` ({{< code src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp MoistMixtureImpl::compute >}}).

#### aneos

`ANEOSImpl` reads a table from `eos_file` and asks it for $(p,T,c_s)$ from $(\rho,e)$ (`"DU->PTL"`), for
$(T,e,c_s)$ from $(\rho,p)$ (`"DP->TUL"`) and for $(p,e,c_s)$ from $(\rho,T)$ (`"DT->PUL"`)
({{< code src/eos/aneos.cpp ANEOSImpl::_cons2prim >}}). It has no species. The adiabatic index is defined from the
table's sound speed, $\gamma=c_s^2\rho/p$ (`"WL->A"` in {{< code src/eos/aneos.cpp ANEOSImpl::compute >}}), the
closure's @eq-ch02-aneos-gamma. Its conversions form $m_a=\rho v_a$ and $v_a=m_a/\rho$ with no metric: they do
not call the lower and raise of @eq-ch02-laws-metric.

#### shallow-water

`ShallowWaterImpl` has rows `IDN` and the three momenta, and no energy row. `"U->W"` divides the momenta by `IDN`
and raises them with the metric ({{< code src/eos/shallow_water.cpp ShallowWaterImpl::_cons2prim >}});
`"W->U"` multiplies and lowers ({{< code src/eos/shallow_water.cpp ShallowWaterImpl::_prim2cons >}}). The wave
speed is $\sqrt{w_{\mathrm{IDN}}}$ (`"WA->L"` in
{{< code src/eos/shallow_water.cpp ShallowWaterImpl::compute >}}), the closure's @eq-ch02-shallow-water-speed;
`"W->A"` and `"W->T"` return an undefined tensor.

Exact and truncated: the shared density and velocity maps are exact inverses as in @sec-ch02-laws. The accuracy
of `moist-mixture` and `aneos` is that of kintera's inversion and of the table interpolation; this section does
not measure it.

### Numerical method

All three are pointwise, like the other closures. `EquationOfStateImpl::create`
({{< code src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp EquationOfStateImpl::create >}}) builds the closure from
`dynamics/equation-of-state/type`; an unknown type stops with "EquationOfState: Unknown type".

A CUDA graph captures a stage only for `ideal-gas` and `ideal-moist`. `StageExecutor::config_reasons`
({{< code src/mesh/stage_executor.cpp StageExecutor::config_reasons >}}) lists every reason a block cannot be
captured; for the closure it checks the type against the set `capture_eos` and, for any other type, adds the
reason "equation of state is `<type>`; capture allows ideal-gas, ideal-moist". In default execution such a
block then runs eager (@sec-ch14). The flow of each closure is drawn in its own section
(@fig-ch02-moist-mixture-flow, @fig-ch02-shallow-water-flow, @fig-ch02-aneos-flow); this overview has no figure
of its own.

| moist-mixture keys | {{< code src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp MoistMixtureImpl::compute >}} | `compute` | `moist-mixture` |
| aneos keys | {{< code src/eos/aneos.cpp ANEOSImpl::compute >}} | `compute` | `aneos` |
| shallow-water keys | {{< code src/eos/shallow_water.cpp ShallowWaterImpl::compute >}} | `compute` | `shallow-water` |
| capture refusal | {{< code src/mesh/stage_executor.cpp StageExecutor::config_reasons >}} | `capture_eos` | `integration/execution` |

: Code map of the other closures. {#tbl-ch02-other-eos-code}

**What is refused, and why.**

1. *Capture.* The reason above; under default execution the block runs eager (@sec-ch14).
2. *Anomaly storage.* `HydroImpl::reset` allows it for `ideal-moist` only (@sec-ch02-laws).
3. *An ideal gas with species.* `EquationOfStateImpl::create` refuses `ideal-gas` with species or reactions
   and names `ideal-moist` and `moist-mixture` as the closures that support them.

Of the four `allclose` calls in `DeviceTest.moist_mixture`, the one on $T$ before and after a change is an
`EXPECT_FALSE`: it asserts that the two temperatures are **not** close. No ctest of the chapter-2 set exercises
`shallow-water`. At the pin both ctests of the table pass.[^other-eos-run]

### Limits

1. **No CUDA graph.** All three closures run eager under default execution (Numerical method).
2. **aneos has no metric.** Its conversions do not lower or raise the momenta; no test runs `aneos` on a
   skewed grid. Not measured.
3. **moist-mixture sound speed: unverified.** `[V10]` holds only if each $Z_n$ depends on its own $\tilde c_n$.
   The kintera check that settles it is named in the open issue of @sec-ch02-moist-mixture; it has not been
   done.
4. **No shallow-water test** in the chapter-2 set.
5. **Untested combinations.** Switch-combination coverage is in @sec-ch12-matrix.

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-642707a05b55]: $\tilde c_n$ — molar concentration of species $n$ [mol m$^{-3}$]; the tilde separates it from the specific heats $c_{v,n}, c_{p,n}$ and the sound speed $c_s$

[^rg-48897db479d9]: $Z_n$ — compressibility factor of gas species $n$, $p_n = Z_n\rho_nR_nT$, dimensionless [-]; $Z_n=1$ at the pin, because kintera's `func2` registry is empty. Capital, because $z$ is the Cartesian height (§1)
<!-- end reader glossary notes -->
